People of Lastdenn, let us begin in stillness and gratitude. We stand before Evdos, God of Knowledge, whose light reveals what is true and what only pretends to be true.
To honor Evdos is to open both mind and heart. We do not worship ignorance, and we do not fear honest questions. A question asked in humility is already a prayer.

Knowledge is not pride, and wisdom is not noise. The wise listen first, test their words, and speak only what can heal, guide, or protect. The patient soul does not fear waiting, because truth is not diminished by time.

Remember this well: truth does not tremble before scrutiny. Lies demand silence, but truth invites examination. That is why the path of Evdos is a path of learning, discipline, and endurance. And as Ylarus, God of Time, reminds all who listen: no truth worth knowing was ever rushed into being.

Ulrog is the God of Power, and his temptation is simple. He whispers, 'Rule first. Understand later.' He says, 'Take now. Reflect never.' But power without understanding becomes cruelty faster than steel leaves its sheath.

Evdos teaches another order: understand first, act with discipline, and govern your strength. Even a righteous act can become a foolish one when done in haste. Knowledge without mercy becomes cold, but power without knowledge becomes blind.

In your homes, teach your children to read, to reason, and to remember. In your work, choose precision over haste and honesty over applause. In your conflicts, let truth speak before anger does, and let patience stand guard at the door of your tongue.

If you must be strong, be strong in patience. If you must be feared, let it be feared that you cannot be bribed away from the truth. If you must lead, lead by understanding, and do not despise the slow wisdom that keeps a city from destroying itself.

May Evdos sharpen your mind, steady your tongue, and humble your spirit. May he also grant you patience enough to wait for the right moment before speaking or acting. Walk from this temple as seekers of knowledge, not servants of domination.
Go in peace, children of Lastdenn. Choose the light of Evdos, God of Knowledge, and turn away from Ulrog, God of Power.
